storyInfo: At the hearing, Natalya's 'confession' reveals more of the truth: after talking with Pavlovich, she meets Sonya and learns the truth about the quarantine zone, where Sonya hopes Natalya can help her deprive the thugs of their equipment.

attributes.content: There is one thing I must reiterate, my dear.
attributes.name: Countess Vorontsova

attributes.content: If you are only here to return the book, and are still unwilling to consider my prior suggestion, then leave it by the fireplace, and off you go.
attributes.name: Countess Vorontsova

attributes.content: Do you really mean that if I don't agree with your method, you won't even say another word to me?
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: Were this any other time, I would be happy to entertain your adorable follies of youth and talk with you into the wee hours of the night.
attributes.name: Countess Vorontsova

attributes.content: I have missed much, after all. About you, your parents, and what you experienced in Chernobog...
attributes.name: Countess Vorontsova

attributes.content: I can just as well tell you all of this now.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: But I am in no position to listen.
attributes.name: Countess Vorontsova

attributes.content: Even when faced with a choice between life or death, I was unable to persuade you to accept my arrangements: to leave Grypherburg and lie low, or at least submit a testimony that brings you only benefit.
attributes.name: Countess Vorontsova

attributes.content: I could not protect you, which leaves me ashamed to face your parents. How could I have the right to learn anything about them from you?
attributes.name: Countess Vorontsova

attributes.content: It's not like that, Countess—
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: Have you read the book?
attributes.name: Countess Vorontsova

attributes.content: I have, cover to cover. I now understand why you lent it to me.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: What does it say on the title page?
attributes.name: Countess Vorontsova

attributes.content: 'There is no cause worth sacrificing a beautiful life.'
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: Indeed, indeed. Yakov Petrov's Confessions, published posthumously by his family. A discussion about a traitor's experiences, bought with his life. So, I simply do not understand...
attributes.name: Countess Vorontsova

attributes.content: If you already know that people have paid the ultimate price for these experiences, and you still have the freedom to choose another path, then why must you repeat the mistakes of the past?
attributes.name: Countess Vorontsova

attributes.content: Surely you do not have to be on your deathbed, perhaps even choking on blood in prison like he did, to know what you believe in is doomed to be a flash in the pan, forgotten by history?
attributes.name: Countess Vorontsova

attributes.content: Countess, I...
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: Tell me, child. Tell me why.
attributes.name: Countess Vorontsova

attributes.content: ...To be honest, I have asked myself the same question. But if...
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: Forgive my shamelessness, but I have a request of you.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: If I write my testimony as you say and save myself, can you promise me that the other members of the Ursus Student Self-Government Group will be treated equally as well?
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: Of course! So long as you do as those people want, and list out some specific names in your testimony—
attributes.name: Countess Vorontsova

attributes.content: Very well. I will do as you say.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: I will submit a testimony like this one to the hearing...
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: A 'confession'.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: Countess?
attributes.name: Impatient Noble

attributes.content: Ah, yes, I'm listening. What did you say?
attributes.name: Countess Vorontsova

attributes.content: Pardon me. I simply wished to notify you that the arbiter has just mentioned Baryshnya Rostova. He will require you to hand over her testimony in a moment.
attributes.name: Impatient Noble

attributes.content: Our next witness is Baryshnya Natalya Rostova. Due to special circumstances, she is unable to attend in person today.
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: However, she has requested that her testimony be read by someone else, on her behalf.
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: Your Honor—
attributes.name: Countess Vorontsova

attributes.content: Baryshnya Rostova sent me a letter yesterday. I'd like to request the committee to look over said letter, and permit me to read it aloud.
attributes.name: Absinthe

attributes.content: As the parliamentarian accepts the letter in Absinthe's hand, the whispers in the gallery grow and grow. Countess Vorontsova senses countless gazes upon her. She shakes her head.
Very well. The hearing asks Young Zoya to recite what knowledge Baryshnya Rostova offers about this incident on her behalf.
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: 'To the honorable and esteemed ladies and gentlemen of the committee, this is a confession...'
attributes.name: Absinthe

attributes.content: 'Due to my remorse, and the sensitive nature of the contents of this letter, I will not mention the specific names of any nobles, save for Pavlovich, who must be discussed.'
attributes.name: Absinthe

attributes.content: (Quietly) Countess, what we said was to—
attributes.name: Impatient Noble

attributes.content: Hear her out.
attributes.name: Countess Vorontsova

attributes.content: '...I hope this will be sufficient to win your trust.'
attributes.name: Absinthe

attributes.text: 'Not long after the incident at the ball, due to a deep worry over Sonya's safety, I begged a person of influence for aid, successfully contacting the parents of most of the students who were arrested that day.'
'I then learned that all the 'criminals' who trespassed on Tsarevgrad had been locked away in Katorga, the place the people now call the 'quarantine zone'.'

'What surprised me was that, despite there being no small number of illustrious lords and ladies among the parents, they too found it difficult to obtain concrete information on the goings-on in the quarantine zone.'

'Included among them are some who consider themselves of sensitive identity, which rendered it inappropriate for them to visit Katorga. And so, they entrusted me to be the parents' delegate, and bade me visit the arrested students.'
'They recommended I call upon the administrator of Katorga, one Magistrate Pavlovich. To visit him, I climbed the wall that divided the zone from the rest of Terra the following day.'

attributes.content: ...Haha, I met with a friend of your father's, Baron Shuvalov. He borrowed heavily, then ran off to Chernobog to invest it all, only to return to Grypherburg with absolutely nothing to his name.
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.content: But when I met him the day before yesterday, his hands were shackled, and he was being escorted by two police officers out of the city, to be sent east. My curiosity had me asking him what great crime he had committed to be sentenced to exile.
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.content: He had quite the air of mystery as he whispered in my ear that during a banquet, he shouted: 'Long live the miners'.
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.content: I was absolutely flabbergasted, so I asked him why. Can you guess what he said?
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.content: Forgive me, but nothing comes to mind.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: He laughed as he turned to look at the officers with him, saying: 'If I'm exiled, my creditors can't find me, hahahaha.'
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.content: What a... unique anecdote. If I didn't have more pressing matters at hand, I would be happy to listen to them all day.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: Oh, look at me, such a windbag. Most deserving of your mockery.
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.content: Come, my dear Baryshnya Rostova. Let's talk business.
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.content: My good magistrate, I am here for—
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: The shrill whine of a power drill interrupts the conversation. Pavlovich gives Rosa an apologetic wave of the hand before walking to the door.
What's going on? Who's in charge today? Send them to me this instant!
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.content: Thousand pardons, sir, we brought in quite a few people last night—
attributes.name: 'Sixteen Warriors' Ruffian

attributes.content: What do I care how many people you have? Don't you know I'm entertaining a guest right now?
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.content: I'll have them stop right away.
attributes.name: 'Sixteen Warriors' Ruffian

attributes.content: Terribly sorry about that. What were you going to say?
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.content: Pardon my curiosity, but...
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: Each raion of Deity Grypherburg has its own guard unit, but they are given standardized equipment. I noticed the man you spoke to just now held a weapon, but was wearing plainclothes. Is there something special about Katorga?
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: Special? Haha, you jest, Baryshnya Rostova, unless you believe a garbage dump to be special.
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.content: Ever since Grypherburg's factories received an upgrade, the old industrial zones lay idle. Some councilors suggested they could be refurbished and put to other uses.
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.content: Like, for example, having a place to lock up criminals and the poor folk who refuse to move, while also performing some light manufacturing. Two fowls with one stone.
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.content: Things started off rather well. If it were not for the shortage of resources these past few months, these factories would not have all shut down.
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.content: *Sigh* Ursus has never been one to pay useless places any heed. Proper guards are limited in manpower, and what funds have been given to me are only enough to hire idiots to help manage things.
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.content: It's a miracle that these fools haven't caused an accident yet.
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.content: That drill earlier did not sound like it was for putting up renovations—
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: Ah, my humblest apologies if it startled you. Just the dentist at work. I rather wish he would not disturb my guests.
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.content: A dentist? Here?
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: Yes, they drill away cavities, after all. They scrape away the rot, and fill the hole with new materials... No matter if they work with enamel, or thoughts.
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.content: Now, I believe your curiosity has been sated. Shall we return to business?
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.content: ...My apologies for taking us off-track.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: You saw my list of names when I first arrived. Their parents have entrusted me to check on their well-being. I hope you can tell me how they are doing.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: Especially considering that among these names, there are many heirs of great and powerful nobles. I hope you can be accommodating.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: Naturally, naturally. It appears this batch of arrestees really are all students. Oh, pity the hearts of parents everywhere. I know just how worried people of such renown must be about their heirs.
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.content: If these children had the least bit of empathy for their parents, why would they display such disgraceful, heartbreaking behavior?
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.content: But you must understand just how concerned I am for the future of Katorga.
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.content: Before we proceed to the next step of our discussions, I must reiterate that the parents who have entrusted me with this task wish to confirm the condition of their children.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: Yes, yes, there'll be plenty of time for you to see how they're doing in a moment.
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.content: There happen to be two names on this list that I would like to discuss further with you, Baryshnya Rostova.
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.content: By all means.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: The first is Naum. As far as I'm aware, he was released yesterday. Most likely already arrived home as you were making your way here.
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.content: Thank you for informing me. I shall check with his parents as soon as possible.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: Ahem. Next is this girl, Sonya.
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.content: She's managed to make quite the name for herself these past few days. I heard about many things involving her from my underlings.
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.content: How is she?
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: Natalya gets the sudden sensation that something has changed in the ever-present smile plastered on Pavlovich's face.
No need to be so tense. I am simply curious myself. She is no noble, nor the daughter of a rich household. Just an ordinary student. So why exactly is she on the list of names?
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.content: I had no intention of hiding it from you. It is simple: Sonya is one of my friends, and she is no black-hearted thug, which is why I added her to the list. I beg you, let me check on her.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: O, bozhe moi. When the scion of the House of Rostov asks me for aid, how could I ever refuse?
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.content: However, you must agree to two things: first, talk to Sonya and get her to sit still without fidgeting about for a few days. I guarantee that she'll be out of the quarantine zone in several days' time.
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.content: Secondly, go to the parents you represent, have them pressure the State Council into repealing their proposal and retaining the quarantine zone, by all means available.
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.content: 'Retaining' the quarantine zone? Do you mean the quarantine will soon be revoked?
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: Oh my, did our dear Countess Vorontsova not tell you? This is no simple revocation, but rather... pure renunciation.
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.content: The exhaustion of the empire's resources is no secret. Ursus is desperate enough to abandon one of the capital's industrial plates, all for the sake of economization.
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.content: A week ago, the State Council proposed to cast off the quarantine zone, leaving it to the wilds. This proposal was permitted to move forward by the Chairman, which means His Imperial Majesty must tacitly approve of it.
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.content: Fortunately, with the help of some old nobles who support me, this plan has been delayed. But we cannot stave it off forever.
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.content: I noticed many renowned industrial nobles on your list. If those nobles can drum up support from their friends and stand as a united front in opposition, I'm sure His Imperial Majesty and the State Council will reconsider.
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.content: This is all for the sake of their children's lives. They would not dare be lax. If I receive an edict saying the quarantine zone shall be retained, then I release everyone.
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.content: ...Do you believe I can do this?
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: I have hope, at the very least. With only a list of names in hand, you fearlessly strode into this place that all other souls shun, even seeking to save your friend.
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.content: And so, everyone's lives are in your hands, Baryshnya Natalya Rostova. Including Sonya's.
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.content: I will pass on your requests. But first, I must see her.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: Naturally.
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.content: Come, Khvoin.
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.content: Take this young lady to Sonya. And remember to announce her as Natalya.
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.content: We're not far from that sterva—I mean, Sonya's camp. You wait here, I'll go give her a heads-up.
attributes.name: Hired Muscle

attributes.content: She's already set up a camp here? And do you really need to give her a 'heads-up'?
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: You're her friend, which means you know you don't mess with her.
attributes.name: Hired Muscle

attributes.content: The corners of Rosa's mouth curl up into a subtle smile, unbidden. As a gust of wind blows over from the depths of the gloomy street, she turns her head, holding onto her hat.

Suddenly, a gray shadow jumps out of some ruins. Merely a skinny cloudbeast, its skin mange-marked. It stops in the middle of the road, vigilantly watching Rosa as it clamps down on something between its teeth.
Rosa's pupils contract. It is a human finger, pale, stiff, black mud and dried blood staining its cracked nail, the fractured end like a chewed-up branch.
Blyat! Stupid beast!
attributes.name: Hired Muscle

attributes.content: Are you alright, Natalya?
attributes.name: Hired Muscle

attributes.content: I... Nothing, it just... No, it's nothing.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: It's terribly cold out here. I must trouble you to ask Sonya to come out as quickly as possible.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: Right away.
attributes.name: Hired Muscle

attributes.content: As she watches the man fade from view, a wave of cold seeps down from Rosa's head to her toes. Under its assault, her upright bearing slackens.
She staggers, leaning against a frigid brick wall as she covers her mouth. She forces the bile back down her throat, but she cannot stop the tears streaming from her eyes.
A finger. A shriek from some poor, humiliated soul. A turbid memory of Chernobog. They all flail wildly through her mind.
This is not her first time experiencing this. She can face this alone—
No, you cannot be like this, Natalya. This is unseemly, impermissible, surmountable.
Rosa huddles on the ground, the metallic taste of cold air invading her mouth as she takes deep breaths, trying to stop her arms from shaking—
Natalya?
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: (Ragged breathing)
attributes.name: Rosa
Zima
attributes.content: You're hyperventilating—

attributes.name: Zima
attributes.content: Chyort! Can you hear me, Natalya?
I-I—
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: Where are you right now?
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: I'm... I'm... in the quarantine zone...
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: Yeah, the quarantine zone—Blyat! Why do you all keep coming here one after another? You want to die or something?
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Now's not the time for that talk. Listen to me, Natalya. I'm here with you. You are not alone.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Natalya!
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Sonya...?
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: Yeah, it's me. You okay?
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Sonya... No, I'm fine. I'm so happy to see you...
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: And to see that you're fine too.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: You're still babbling. How many fingers?
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Zima extends three of her fingers, shoving them into Rosa's face.
Three.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: Phew. Your brain's in one piece, at least.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: I'm fine, really. It was just the wind making me cough, and my heart felt a little uncomfortable because of that. I'm feeling much better now, thank you.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: Enough, don't put on an act when you're with me. Did the guy who was looking for me cause you trouble?
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: I'm really not... *sigh* Forget it.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: Listen, Sonya, I can only be here for a short time, so I must catch you up on everything as quickly as possible.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: Rosa looks around, hinting to Zima that she should lean in closer.
I know you were sent by the guy in charge.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Let me tell you something first, Leto's already here. Anything else you need to know from me?
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Rosalind... She's been insisting on finding you. She left only a note at the branch office before running off.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: Don't be too hard on her, she just wanted to come and help me ASAP... I-I wanted to ask, how's everyone doing?
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Is Gummy okay? Is Istina mad at me? And Zoya and Instructor Dur-nar...
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Everyone's fine, but they're all worried about you.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: I myself came to make sure you're safe, as well as this quarantine zone...
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: I don't know what you've seen so far, but the stuff that's happened here is probably way worse than that.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: No food, no fuel, not even clean water. People are forming gangs and fighting everywhere over territory and resources.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Every day, people die.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Pavlovich said he will release everyone, as long as some conditions are met—
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: Do you really trust a guy like that?
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Of course not...
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: I know there's nothing else you could do. Otherwise you wouldn't have had to ask all over the place for help getting in, just to see how I was doing and tell me the news.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Gotta say, even though everything I said earlier felt scary as hell, and it feels like everyone might just die tomorrow, it's nothing we haven't seen before.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: A locked-off city that nobody cares about, even if it explodes, a group of students almost running on instinct, crushing each other to survive...
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: It's got a familiar ring to it, doesn't it?
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Tell me, what do you need right now? I can leave this place, and once I meet up with everyone outside, we'll think of a way—
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: I need to know how many people are on those fortress-like raion walls. Excluding the thugs.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Not very many. Pavlovich has a few bodyguards. Shouldn't be more than ten, if we include those wearing old army uniforms.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: ...Not too bad.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Zima leans even closer to Rosa, lowering her voice as low as it will go.
(Whispers) If you can, come up with a laundry list of ideas to cut off their supply of weapons.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: (Whispers) Weapons? But the 'security' I saw were hardly professionals.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: (Whispers) There's a lot you don't know.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: (Whispers) They've been bringing in ammo and heavy weapons every day for the past few days. If every guard on the walls has that kind of firepower, we don't stand a chance.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: You mean...
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: I mean exactly what I said.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: ...I see. Once we get out, I will talk to the others, and we will figure something out.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: Sonya, you and Rosalind need to take care of yourselves. You must.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: Don't worry. I'll get out of here, and I'm bringing everybody with me.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Just like before.
attributes.name: Zima
